name: Black-crowned Fulvetta
rangeDescription: Southern vietnam (langbian plateau)
description: Adorable small fulvetta with large, liquid cartoon eyes. Plain brown overall.

name: Cerulean Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sangihe islands (northeast of sulawesi)
description: An unmistakable, fairly large blue flycatcher confined to Sangihe island. Entirely pale blue, with a paler belly and a conspicuous white eye-ring which is the most striking identification feature.

name: Short-tailed Starling
rangeDescription: Sulawesi, java, bali, lesser sundas, and southern philippines (mindanao)
description: Glossy greenish starling with red eyes. Juvenile is brownish above, with streaked white underparts.

name: Saffron-cowled Blackbird
rangeDescription: Paraguay to southeastern brazil, uruguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Brightly colored blackbird. Males have a black nape and upper back; face, underparts, and rump are yellow tinged with orange.

name: Inca Tern
rangeDescription: Islands off peru and chile; ranges rarely north to ecuador
description: Beautiful and distinctive dark tern of the Humboldt Current. Found along rocky coasts and at harbors and piers where it is often confiding; less often found at sandy beaches and river mouths.

name: Gray-backed Thrush
rangeDescription: Breeds eastern siberia, manchuria, and northern korea; winters to southeastern asia
description: Brightly colored thrush of well-shaded undergrowth in a variety of habitats, from deep hilly forests to city parks and gardens. Male has clean pale gray upperparts and a bright orange belly, female and immature male replace gray with brown and have dark streaking on the throat and chest.

name: Bay-ringed Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (espírito santo) to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Small flycatcher with a long slender tail, which is often held cocked. Note the diagnostic cinnamon patches around the eyes contrasting with a green head, pale eye, and yellow throat.

name: Spot-tailed Antwren
rangeDescription: Eastern venezuela to the guianas and northeastern amazonian brazil
description: Small antbird of rainforest canopy; somewhat more common in forests with sandy soils. From below, note clean white underparts and heavy bill.

name: Tawny-tufted Toucanet
rangeDescription: Far eastern colombia and southern venezuela to northwestern brazil
description: Small toucan. Look for the blue patch on a reddish bill.

name: Rufous-bellied Heron
rangeDescription: Locally in eastern and southeastern africa
description: Small, dark, chunky heron. There are rufous patches on the wing and belly; this can be hard to see when perched but is conspicuous in flight.

name: Pied Bronze-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Moluccas (tayandu and kai islands) and tanimbar islands (yamdena and larat)
description: Striking small cuckoo endemic to the Tanimbar, and Kai and Tayando Islands (where rare) of the southeastern Moluccas. Male is dark iridescent green above and white below, with a bright red patch of bare facial skin around each eye, and a large white wing patch.

name: Atlas Wheatear
rangeDescription: Morocco to northeastern algeria; winters to mauritania
description: Small thrush-like bird with distinctive black-and-white tail pattern that is striking in flight. Breeding male has a black face, throat and wing, gray back and crown, and white underparts.

name: Orange Minivet
rangeDescription: Western peninsular india (southeastern gujarat southward through the western ghats, and southwestern eastern ghats in tamil nadu), and sri lanka
description: Brightly-colored forest bird with a long tail. Male is decked out in black and orange-red, female in gray and yellow.

name: Sooty Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Southeastern bolivia to central argentina, eastern paraguay, uruguay, and southern brazil
description: A very small and long-tailed flycatcher with fairly uniformly dark-gray plumage. It has a dark bill and legs with a slightly paler throat and two indistinct wingbars.

name: Orange-eyed Flatbill
rangeDescription: Tropical southern colombia and northeastern peru north of the amazon
description: Rare flycatcher found in seasonally flooded swamp forest in lowlands east of the Andes. Pale eye, wide bill, buffy throat and breast, gray crown, and lack of facial markings help separate it from similar species such as Gray-crowned Flycatcher.

name: Biak Coucal
rangeDescription: Biak (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: A poorly known, mid-sized coucal endemic to Biak island. All black plumage, distinctive yellow iris, straightish bill and a fierce-looking face.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Plumbeous Ibis
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southern brazil to bolivia, paraguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Distinctive gray ibis with a white forehead and bushy crest. Favors marshes, rice fields, and ponds, but also occurs in grassland, pastures, and savanna.

name: Green-backed Tailorbird
rangeDescription: Northern and central luzon (philippines)
description: A small, long-billed, long-tailed bird of dense tangled undergrowth in lowland and foothill forest and bamboo in northern Luzon. Has olive-green wings, back, and tail, a pale gray belly, a gray chest with streaks, a rufous cap reaching below the eye, and orange legs.

name: Great Inca-Finch
rangeDescription: Arid andes of peru (ancash to southern lima)
description: Handsome finch-like bird found only on the west slope of the Andes in central Peru. Adult is gray with chestnut wings and black face and throat.

name: Doherty's Bushshrike
rangeDescription: Mountains of rwanda, burundi, western uganda, eastern democratic republic of the congo, and western kenya
description: Beautiful bird with an olive back, red throat and forehead, yellow belly, and black chest band. There is a rare morph in which the red is replaced with yellow.
